Not allowed for a release: replace it before the public launch (a patch of ztracing that drops the zlog dependency, or an Apache-2.0 relicense upstream). Listed so that the check stays green for what is already there and fails for any new one.

wayland-protocols-plasma.license: MIT AND MIT-CMU AND BSD-3-Clause AND LGPL-2.1-or-later
wayland-protocols-plasma.reason: The crate (MIT) turns the XML protocol descriptions of KDE's plasma-wayland-protocols into interface tables at build time. Of its 30 files, 17 are LGPL-2.1-or-later (blur.xml, the one gpui_linux uses, among them), 9 MIT-CMU, 1 BSD-3-Clause, the rest MIT. Only the generated interface tables are compiled in; no LGPL library code is linked. The four license texts are shipped, and the LGPL is allowed here as a notice only.
